definitions.explanation: Having a pleasant, rich aroma. A literary or elegant way to describe a good smell.
Describes results, conditions, or situations that are favorable. Most commonly used in the negative form to mean unsatisfactory.

⟦{焼|や}きたて→焼きたて：16735_yakitate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦パン→パン：00553_pan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{芳|かんば}しい⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{漂|ただよ}う→漂う：04356_tadayou⟧。

notes:
Has two distinct uses: a literary sense for pleasant aromas, and a practical sense for favorable conditions. The second sense is overwhelmingly used in the negative ({芳|かんば}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {芳|かんば}しい⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ — a fragrant aroma
- {芳|かんば}しい⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ — a pleasant smell
- ⟦{成績|せいせき}→成績：03379_seiseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{芳|かんば}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — results are unsatisfactory
- ⟦{経過|けいか}→経過：05578_keika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{芳|かんば}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — progress is unfavorable
- ⟦{評判|ひょうばん}→評判：03586_hyouban⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{芳|かんば}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ — reputation is not good

USAGE:
Sense 1 is literary and somewhat formal. For everyday descriptions of smell, {良|い}い⟦{匂|にお}い→匂い：00874_nioi⟧ or {良|い}い⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧ are more common. Sense 2 is almost exclusively used in the negative form {芳|かんば}しく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧, which is a polished, indirect way of saying something is going poorly.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{香|かお}り→香り：00189_kaori⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{良|い}い — smells good (everyday expression)
- ⟦{好|こう}{調|ちょう}→好調：12209_kouchou⟧ — favorable, going well (direct positive form)
